assessment.title: Borsetshire Cyber Resilience Assessment 2025/26
assessment.scope_description: Comprehensive NCSC CAF v4.0 statutory cyber resilience audit across all tier 1 citizen services, corporate active directory, and operational networks.

Borsetshire Major Cyber Incident Response Plan v3.0

A1.a.rationale: Cabinet and Chief Executive receive quarterly cyber resilience posture briefings with formal risk appetite thresholds set for statutory public services.

A1.b.rationale: Formally appointed Head of Cyber Security & SIRO with direct reporting access to Section 151 Officer and Corporate Management Team.

A1.c.rationale: Risk management framework aligns with ISO 27001:2022 and NCSC CAF guidance, refreshed semi-annually.

A2.a.rationale: Comprehensive asset register maintained in ServiceNow CMDB covering all council end-user devices, hypervisors, and SaaS services.

A2.b.rationale: Network topologies mapped for main datacenter and civic offices, but remote depot networks and IoT traffic lack real-time visibility.

A2.c.rationale: Council dependencies on external cloud vendors documented, but downstream sub-processor risk audits are inconsistent.

A3.a.rationale: Annual mandatory cyber awareness modules for all 2,400 council employees with 96.4% completion rate.

A4.a.rationale: Supply chain security requirements incorporated into all procurement tender documentation and contracts over £50k.

A4.b.rationale: High-risk SaaS suppliers are vetted during onboarding, but continuous monitoring of supplier vulnerability disclosures is informal.

B1.a.rationale: Critical Single Point of Failure: The Electoral Registration AD forest shares an unisolated bridge with the legacy corporate domain, presenting a direct lateral traversal route.

B1.b.rationale: Security architecture reviewed during capital project design, but technical debt exemptions have accumulated without clear retirement dates.

B2.a.rationale: Legacy Remote Desktop Gateway used by Adult Social Care out-of-hours social workers lacks modern FIDO2/MFA conditional access enforcement.

B2.b.rationale: Strict identity lifecycle with automated joiners, movers, leavers (JML) integration between HR payroll and Entra ID.

B2.c.rationale: Privileged access management (PAM) deployed for domain admins, but local administrator accounts on civic building IoT devices remain static.

B2.d.rationale: Granular role-based access control applied across statutory revenues, housing benefit, and council tax databases.

B3.a.rationale: Comprehensive acceptable use policy and annual security pledge signed by all staff and elected members.

B3.b.rationale: Physical perimeter security, RFID keycard badges, and CCTV logging active at County Hall datacenter.

B3.c.rationale: All staff laptops enforced with BitLocker AES-256 full disk encryption and USB storage device restriction.

B3.d.rationale: All mobile devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune MDM with biometric containerization and remote wipe capability.

B3.e.rationale: Secure disposal contract in place with certified data destruction, but historical paper files in archived storage await shredding audit.

B4.a.rationale: Vulnerable network segmentation: Adult Social Care SQL databases share a flat Layer-2 VLAN with building management controllers and civic hall HVAC.

B4.b.rationale: Next-generation Palo Alto firewalls deployed at all perimeter edges with TLS 1.3 decryption and deep packet inspection.

B4.c.rationale: CrowdStrike Falcon EDR active on 100% of Windows and Linux servers with automated endpoint isolation.

B4.d.rationale: Email protection via Microsoft Defender for Office 365, but DMARC policy is currently set to 'none' rather than 'reject'.

B5.a.rationale: Operating system security patches applied monthly, but third-party application patching for specialized housing software lags up to 60 days.

B5.b.rationale: Weekly automated Qualys vulnerability scans conducted across all internal and external council subnets.

B5.c.rationale: Formal emergency patch management protocol tested and executed within 24 hours for actively exploited CISA KEV vulnerabilities.

B6.a.rationale: Official classification scheme (OFFICIAL / OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE) enforced across Microsoft Purview labels.

B6.b.rationale: All citizen data transmitted externally is protected with TLS 1.3 or PGP-encrypted SFTP tunnels.

C1.a.rationale: Centralized Microsoft Sentinel SIEM ingesting syslog from all firewalls, domain controllers, and EDR agents.

C1.b.rationale: 24/7/365 Managed Security Operations Centre (SOC) monitoring active with 15-minute mean time to alert.

C1.c.rationale: Log retention set to 180 days in hot storage, but immutable cold storage archival for forensic readiness is under-provisioned.

C1.d.rationale: Automated threat intelligence feeds from NCSC Early Warning and CISP ingested directly into SIEM.

C2.a.rationale: CSIRT incident playbooks exist for ransomware and credential stuffing, but lack specific guidance for operational technology (OT) incidents.

D1.a.rationale: Critical Resiliency Deficit: Revenues & Housing Benefits database backups are synchronized to a secondary SAN on the same domain without air-gapped immutable storage.

D1.b.rationale: Disaster recovery tabletop exercises conducted annually, but full bare-metal restore drills for Revenues systems have not been rehearsed in 18 months.

D1.c.rationale: Alternative cloud communications channels (Signal & secondary M365 tenant) configured for crisis response command team.

D2.a.rationale: Post-incident review policy mandates blameless post-mortems and remediation tracking within 14 days of major incidents.

D2.b.rationale: Lessons learned feeds directly into council enterprise risk register and annual cyber training curriculum.

identified_gaps.title: Legacy Remote Access Gateway Lacking MFA for Social Care
identified_gaps.description: Out-of-hours social workers access adult case notes via an unpatched RD Gateway that supports single-factor password authentication without FIDO2 or Conditional Access.
identified_gaps.service_name: Adult & Children's Social Care Case Management

identified_gaps.title: Unsegmented Adult Social Care DB on Shared Civic Network
identified_gaps.description: Statutory child protection SQL server resides in a flat network segment shared with building management system (BMS) controllers and public kiosk terminals.
identified_gaps.service_name: Adult & Children's Social Care Case Management

identified_gaps.title: Missing Immutable Air-Gapped Backups for Revenues & Housing Benefits
identified_gaps.description: Revenues and Council Tax SQL databases rely on co-located SAN snapshots accessible via domain admin credentials, vulnerable to ransomware wiper attacks.
identified_gaps.service_name: Revenues, Council Tax & Housing Benefits Processing

identified_gaps.title: Single Point of Failure in Electoral Register Active Directory Domain
identified_gaps.description: Electoral roll server trusts legacy corporate domain without isolation, enabling complete compromise of statutory election systems during a corporate breach.

identified_gaps.title: DMARC Configuration Set to 'None' for Citizen Communications
identified_gaps.description: Council email domain lacks DMARC 'reject' enforcement, enabling threat actors to spoof council official communications regarding council tax and housing benefits.

identified_gaps.title: Third-Party Specialized Housing Software Lacks Patch SLAs
identified_gaps.description: Northgate Housing Repairs application running on legacy Windows 2016 VM with 60-day lag on critical vendor security patches.

identified_gaps.title: Unmapped Remote Depot Subnets in Waste Cleansing Operations
identified_gaps.description: Cleansing depot IoT routing gateways operate on static unmonitored subnets outside central SIEM visibility.

identified_gaps.title: Static Passwords on Civic Centre Smart Metering IoT Devices
identified_gaps.description: Council premises energy management sensors use shared static administrative credentials across 14 council properties.
identified_gaps.service_name: Corporate Active Directory / Microsoft 365 & Staff Payroll

identified_gaps.title: Inadequate Cold Storage Forensics Log Retention
identified_gaps.description: Audit logs for Planning Application web portals are retained for only 90 days instead of statutory 12-month compliance window.

identified_gaps.title: SaaS Booking Portal Vendor Lacks Ongoing Threat Auditing
identified_gaps.description: Leisure centre bookings portal hosted by third party without annual SOC2 Type II or ISO 27001 certificate verification.

identified_gaps.title: Archived Physical Paper Records Awaiting Shredding Audit
identified_gaps.description: Historical housing paper applications held in County Hall basement without formal destruction sign-off.

identified_gaps.title: Missing Operational Technology Incident Playbook
identified_gaps.description: Council incident playbooks cover ransomware and data breach, but lack steps for building automation lockouts or smart lighting compromises.

remediation_tasks.title: Decommission Legacy RD Gateway and Enforce Entra ID MFA
remediation_tasks.description: Migrate all Adult Social Care out-of-hours workers to Azure App Proxy with Conditional Access and FIDO2 passwordless keys.
technical_steps: Audit active RD Gateway sessions and user accounts
Deploy Azure Application Proxy connectors on internal DMZ
Configure Entra ID Conditional Access requiring MFA and compliant council Intune devices
Distribute YubiKeys to 35 on-call social workers
Decommission legacy gateway server and revoke public DNS entry

remediation_tasks.title: Microsegment Social Care SQL Database from Building Management VLAN
remediation_tasks.description: Deploy Cisco ACI / Palo Alto microsegmentation rules isolating statutory social care case databases into dedicated private VRF with strict stateful inspection.
technical_steps: Map all SQL inbound connections from case management application servers
Create dedicated secure VRF 'Tier1-SocialCare-Core'
Configure firewall access control lists (ACL) blocking all IoT/BMS ingress
Execute automated port scan validation from civic network segment

remediation_tasks.title: Implement AWS S3 Object Lock Air-Gapped Immutable Backups
remediation_tasks.description: Provision AWS London (eu-west-2) S3 bucket with strict Object Lock in Compliance Mode for Revenues & Housing Benefits SQL backups.
technical_steps: Procure AWS GovCloud account with isolated root account credentials in physical safe
Configure Veeam Cloud Connect repository with S3 Object Lock 30-day retention
Conduct full restore simulation of Council Tax SQL database into isolated sandbox
Sign off section 151 officer compliance assurance certificate

remediation_tasks.title: Establish Dedicated Air-Gapped Forest for Electoral Management
remediation_tasks.description: Sever bilateral forest trust and isolate Electoral Services into a hardened standalone Active Directory domain prior to local elections.
technical_steps: Provision two hardened domain controllers in dedicated VLAN
Migrate electoral registration workstations to new forest with PAM
Sever legacy domain trusts and enforce Kerberos armoring
Conduct vulnerability validation and penetration test

remediation_tasks.title: Enforce DMARC Reject Policy on borsetshire.gov.uk
remediation_tasks.description: Transition DMARC policy from 'p=none' to 'p=reject' across all council public domains and citizen notifications.
technical_steps: Analyze Valimail DMARC reporting for 30 days
Align SPF and DKIM keys for third-party council mailing tools (GovDelivery, Civica)
Update public DNS records to 'v=DMARC1; p=reject; pct=100'
Verify delivery with NCSC Mail Check service

remediation_tasks.title: Upgrade Northgate Housing Management Application Server
remediation_tasks.description: Migrate Northgate Housing from end-of-life Windows Server 2016 to Windows Server 2022 with automated patch maintenance schedule.
technical_steps: Provision new Server 2022 VM in hypervisor cluster
Install latest vendor application build with vendor professional services
Migrate database schema and execute user acceptance testing
Decommission legacy 2016 instance

remediation_tasks.title: Deploy Azure Log Analytics Dedicated 365-Day Cold Workspace
remediation_tasks.description: Configure long-term archive tier in Azure Log Analytics for statutory 365-day security incident forensic retention.
technical_steps: Provision Azure Log Analytics workspace with Archive Tier enabled
Set retention policy to 365 days across all security event tables
Validate cost model with Section 151 finance lead

remediation_tasks.title: Rotate IoT Administrative Credentials and Deploy LAPS
remediation_tasks.description: Implement Windows LAPS (Local Administrator Password Solution) and randomized credentials on all civic premises IoT endpoints.
technical_steps: Install Entra LAPS client extension across all civic endpoint devices
Rotate legacy shared passwords to 24-character random strings
Restrict retrieval permissions to SIRO and On-Call Lead

remediation_tasks.title: Establish Continuous Third-Party Risk Monitoring for SaaS Portals
remediation_tasks.description: Subscribe to SecurityScorecard or Panorays for automated continuous monitoring of council leisure and library SaaS suppliers.
technical_steps: Procure Crown Commercial Service G-Cloud software licenses
Upload roster of 42 council digital suppliers
Configure automated threshold alerts for supplier rating drops below 'B'

remediation_tasks.title: Develop and Exercise Operational Technology (OT) Cyber Playbook
remediation_tasks.description: Author incident response procedures for smart building systems, traffic CCTV, and public guest Wi-Fi network compromises.
technical_steps: Consult with council facilities management and highway engineering teams
Draft step-by-step containment protocols for building management systems
Facilitate desktop tabletop exercise with council emergency planning unit
